summary: Comprehensive testing of doctor profile and receipt features completed. Backend: 100% pass (9/9 tests). Frontend: 100% pass (15/15 features). All new features working correctly: doctor profile management (GET/PUT /api/doctor-profile), profile screen with live preview, mode of payment field (Cash/UPI/Cheque/Bank Transfer), auto-generated receipt_no (REC-DDMM-NNN format), updated PDF receipt format with doctor details, and CSV export with new columns.

minor.issue: Receipt number generation uses count of all documents. If cases are deleted, count decreases which could lead to duplicate receipt numbers. Should use a counter collection or max receipt number.
No validation on mode_of_payment field - accepts any string value. Should validate against allowed values: ['Cash', 'UPI', 'Cheque', 'Bank Transfer']

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, should use 'boxShadow'
react_native_issues.note: Cosmetic warning only, not breaking functionality. Same as previous iterations.

action_items: Consider implementing a counter collection or using max receipt number for receipt_no generation to prevent duplicates after deletions
Add backend validation for mode_of_payment field to only accept: Cash, UPI, Cheque, Bank Transfer

✅ PUT /api/doctor-profile creates/updates profile with upsert operation

✅ POST /api/cases generates receipt_no in format REC-DDMM-NNN
✅ Receipt number persists in database and returned in case responses
✅ Mode of payment field added to CaseCreate and CaseResponse models with default 'Cash'
✅ Add Case form has Mode of Payment dropdown with 4 options: Cash, UPI, Cheque, Bank Transfer
✅ Mode of payment persists correctly in database
✅ Case detail screen displays receipt_no and mode_of_payment
✅ CSV export includes new columns: Receipt No, Payment Status, Mode of Payment

✅ All new endpoints follow existing patterns (async/await, error handling)
✅ All new UI components have proper testID attributes
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Test cases were created during testing and remain in database for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All doctor profile and receipt features verified working. Doctor profile can be created/updated via PUT /api/doctor-profile and retrieved via GET. Profile screen has live preview. Mode of payment field works with 4 options. Receipt numbers auto-generate in REC-DDMM-NNN format. CSV export includes all new columns.
